claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_trigger_class_feature_family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fleet Step fires automatically on a conditioned window (bonus_action_window, excluding Step of the Wind itself). It has no explicit activation, no use_count, and no rest reset. The current ClassFeatureMechanics union contains only 'activation', which mandates activationCost + resource (UseCountResource) + resetCadence. A passive/triggered family is needed for features that fire on a turn-structure event rather than being explicitly activated.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_feature_use_at_waived_cost
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is 'grant use of Step of the Wind without expending an additional Bonus Action'. Existing ClassFeatureEffect variants (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) do not cover this — grant_extra_action grants a generic extra action, not a specific named feature at a waived cost. A new effect variant referencing a feature by id with a cost override is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: bonus_action_exclusion_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger has a named-feature exclusion condition ('other than Step of the Wind'). The current surface has no filter grammar on window triggers for class features. A closed filter shape — or a ConditionedTrigger variant — is needed to represent 'bonus action, excluding named feature X'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind
